div.div:
Solid border = running today (M1a) · dashed = planned. Blue = OpenTelemetry Collector · green = generation site · amber = impaired WAN.
poll = the poller is the Modbus master: it requests and the meter answers — devices never push. OpenTelemetry has no Modbus receiver, so the poller is a separate process; the edge collector is still the only thing northbound, and it stamps energy.site.id, energy.site.kind and geo.latitude/longitude on every signal so the map needs no knowledge of the sites.
